document.abstract: A short story of the evolution of the photographic process, describing the various stages of improvement in speed and quality. The historical development of the photographic process is treated briefly, from the camera obscura through the early experiments of the daguerreotype, the discovery and use of hypo, the use of collodion and gelatin emulsions, to the panchromatic emulsion and the reversal process.
